snippet.title: Clay Jam Classic
snippet.description:
Clay Jam is back!

Once upon a time, there was a game made entirely of clay. A game of hope and of squashing monsters. A game played by millions. 

But a darkness came and Clay Jam was lost to the world. We thought it was lost forever. But hope has a way of surviving in even the grimmest of times, and the monsters are rising up once more to fight for kindness, togetherness and strangeness! 

Are you ready to roll again?!

Clay Jam Classic is an uplifting action game for mobile, out now!

Download Clay Jam Classic here:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/clay-jam-classic/id6759738137
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yumyumyukyuk.clayjamclassic
